original_metadata.title: Explicit strong connection on a finite piecewise principal right comodule algebra over a cocommutative Hopf algebra, with unital colinear local splittings
original_metadata.author: Bartosz Zielinski
original_metadata.source_title: Piecewise Principal Coactions of Co-Commutative Hopf Algebras
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The construction combines local strong connections with ordered convolution defect factors that telescope after applying every covering projection. The bundled multipullback reconstruction builds compatible colinear splittings by a double induction over the covering and a distributive-lattice basis construction, avoiding an assumption that a global strong connection has already been chosen.

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Read complete Theorem1 proof and full local splitting support Theorem2 and Lemmas1,3,4 in Sections4-5. Ground field K is arbitrary; all tensors algebraic. H is cocommutative, the finite family is piecewise principal as in Definition5, each local strong connection takes values in Vi tensor Vi, and alpha_i is unital and H-colinear splitting on Vi. The proof checks both colinearities, unitality and the counit identity through the convolution telescoping defect and intersection of covering kernels. Theorem2 supplies the explicit multipullback splitting induction, with compatible local kernel-preserving splittings built through the new lattice basis and coinvariant lift. Existing principality/covering criterion and local strong-connection lift from published[12] are background. No separate splitting helper, Toeplitz-sphere example or noncocommutative extension is counted.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Theorem1 under its finite piecewise principal cocommutative-H and supplied-local-splitting hypotheses. The selected expression for ell uses ordered defect factors Ti from the source. Sections4-5 give constructive support for the local splittings; no assumption-free arbitrary Hopf-algebra generalization is asserted.
original_metadata.editorial_warning: Source Definition4 calls ideal sum/intersection meet/join in reversed lattice terminology; the actual distributivity and kernel conditions are explicit and the source bytes remain unchanged. Lemma3 calls B_Gamma=pi(A_Gamma) although its construction concerns basis vectors contained in the image; the preceding basis and lifting construction explicitly specify the selected representatives. No editorial rewriting of the proof.
